assessment: Expiry is a contextual action selected only from complete owner-local WAITING/ACTIVE accounting after canonical balance-anchor verification; no request-ID selection query is added. Reserved requests are permitted for expiry but not cancellation.

The unchanged private expire ABI invokes the unchanged public contract deadline/state checks. Original fee estimation simulates at preparation and again at explicit submit. A changed fee above the saved ceiling refuses before the durable submission fence. Browser time/public event data do not authorize expiry.

The original encrypted workflow retains exact request arguments and Bok scope; restart validates that scope. Original journal and workflow submitting/unknown fences prevent a second prepare/send and retain canonical reconciliation behavior. Expiry does not add a replacement/replay route.

Unreserved credit is returned while unresolved reserved liability remains fenced by the unchanged contract. UI states this at selection/review/confirmation and renders FENCED accounting without treating refunded amounts as extra available credit.
Current state may change between review and inclusion; unchanged authoritative contract execution can revert the transaction. This component makes no atomic snapshot or guaranteed-refund promise.
